in_marathi.name: Dhiren
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Intelligent, Brave, Fearless
in_marathi.long_meaning: Dhiren हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Dhiren is a Sanskrit name for boys. It is derived from the Sanskrit word 'dhi' which means intellect or understanding, and 'ren' which means ruler or king. The name Dhiren signifies a ruler of intellect or a brave and fearless leader. In Hindu mythology, Dhiren is also an epithet of Lord Indra, the god of rain and thunder.
